mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressures, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month does not lead to negative 5-day forward returns in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 2 consecutive months does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% in 1 month does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If a decrease in FEDFUNDS does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in more than 55% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE) and falling nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combination of rising UNRATE and falling PAYEMS does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts (HOUST) combined with a decrease in real final sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based demand slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combination of declining HOUST and RSAFS does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5% signals a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 5% during a tightening cycle does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in more than 55% of the triggered instances.
